notes: The Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type with the same header layout as the Uno R3.
Breadboard coordinates are read from the diagram. The image is flipped relative to the catalogue, so rows f-j (the top block in the image) are bank 'b'.

The green wire goes from pin 2 to hole 3b.g. The 220 ohm resistor spans 3b.h to 6b.h. The LED's bent (longer) leg is the anode at 6b.i, and the straight leg is the cathode at 8b.i. The black wire goes from GND (beside AREF, taken as GND.1) to 8b.h.
The resistor and the LED anode share column 6 in bank b, so the strip joins them. The LED cathode and the GND wire share column 8.
The tutorial says the built-in LED can be used instead. The graph models the external LED circuit shown in the diagram.
A USB cable for power and programming is implied but not shown in the circuit image, so it is not included.
The 220 ohm resistor value comes from the parts list. The resistor body in the image is small and its bands are not clearly readable.
